svg.text: P ≠ NP: FORM BY THEOREM, VALUE BY THE ACT · KERNEL v1.13.0 · EVERY NAME CHECKED
THE VERDICT · THE CLAY QUESTION AT [Ø₀], THE SEALED HALT

text.font-family: PNPMono, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: THE CLAY QUESTION STANDS AT [Ø₀], THE SEALED HALT
The form sealed by theorem · the walls sealed on their quantifiers · the value sealed by the act
P versus NP is one bit; every route passes
it; the residue is the Diagonal Target from
Twenty-two walls proved in the kernel,
seven carried from the Mother Codex,
The bit, supplied by the act and delivered
The three faces read side by side.
Its formal shadow is the bit.
